Duolingo Timed Research: Keep It Up!
Trainers around the world may speak different languages, but the excitement of discovering a Pokémon is universal!
Learning how Trainers share their discoveries in other languages can help us work together, wherever our research takes us.
Let me know which language you would like to practice. Don't worry! I’ll give you a few helpful hints.
With your wits and curiosity, I have a feeling you’ll surprise even yourself!
Let’s begin with some essential skills every Trainer should learn.
We’ll start by seeking out Pokémon around us. Keep an eye out for familiar numbers, repeated words, and patterns across these tasks.
Follow your Trainer instincts—you may understand more than you expect.
And between you and me... Keep a Poké Ball handy and make every throw count!
Excellent work! Look at all the Pokémon you caught, %PLAYERNAME%!
I’ll need your help in the field for the next step. We can’t do this bit in the lab!
Why don’t you check out some of the PokéStops or Gyms around you?
The journey is about more than the destination, so keep an eye out for new discoveries along your way.
Great work, %PLAYERNAME%! You’ve explored so much of the world around you!
Now, let’s look into Pokémon growth. They can become stronger through training, and we’re no stranger to evolution!
And if you have an Egg, bring it along on your adventure. Hatching it may lead to a new encounter!
Those are all the hints I can offer right now. Let’s see how much you and your Pokémon can grow together!
Splendid, %PLAYERNAME%! It’s always a delight to see all your care and hard work pay off, isn’t it?
Now, let’s put everything you’ve discovered into practice. The final tasks should feel familiar.
